propositions: Jira-specific probe mechanics (REST URL shape, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) currently reside in backend-neutral core inbound_probe.py and must be relocated to adapters/jira/probe.py to eliminate adapters.jira imports from core

A new runtime-checkable SupportsAbsenceProbe capability Protocol must be introduced in _backend.py to allow vendors to implement probe_remote(), enabling multi-backend probe dispatch without core vendor code

run_differs.py probe dispatch at line 369 must be refactored to route through SupportsAbsenceProbe capability check, with the backend instance hoisted and passed as a parameter, degrading to UNREACHABLE for backends lacking the capability
AST neutrality gate in test_backend_neutrality.py must be extended to enforce zero adapters.jira imports in inbound_probe.py
